program:
PARAMS = {
    "I":    (0.4e-6, 0.25e-6, 0.6e-6),   # core branch / output current
    "VP":   (0.60, 0.45, 0.75),          # PTAT voltage I*R2 at 27C
    "a":    (0.70, 0.60, 0.90),          # I*R3 (sets divider k)
    "Lp":   (8.0, 3.0, 12.0),            # PMOS mirror length
    "Ln":   (4.0, 1.0, 8.0),             # NMOS beta-multiplier length
    "gmp":  (12.0, 8.0, 16.0),           # PMOS gm/Id
    "gmn":  (20.0, 14.0, 25.0),          # NMOS gm/Id (weak inversion)
    "Cg":   (2e-12, 0.5e-12, 4e-12),     # PMOS gate-to-vdd cap (PSRR)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    I = p["I"]; K = 8
    Ln = p["Ln"]
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Ln, I, vds=0.45)
    m2 = lut.size("n", p["gmn"], Ln, K * I, vds=0.8, vsb=0.08)
    W2 = m2.W
    vg = m1.vgs
    vs = 0.08
    for _ in range(12):
        lo, hi = 0.0, vg
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            idm = lut.op("n", W2, Ln, mid, max(0.85 - vs, 0.1), vs)["Id"]
            if idm > I:
                hi = mid
            else:
                lo = mid
        vgs2 = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        vs_new = max(vg - vgs2, 0.02)
        vs = 0.5 * vs + 0.5 * vs_new
    R1 = vs / I
    R2 = p["VP"] / I
    R3 = p["a"] / I

    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmp"], p["Lp"], I, vds=0.8)

    n = Netlist("vdd vref vss")
    # beta-multiplier PTAT core
    n.dev("M3", "na", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M4", "nb", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.dev("M1", "na", "na", "vss", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "nb", "na", "x2", "vss", m2, m=K)
    n.R("R1", "x2", "vss", R1)
    n.C("CG", "nb", "vdd", p["Cg"])
    # output leg: vref = R3/(R2+R3) * (Veb3 + I*R2)
    n.dev("M5", "vref", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", mp)
    n.R("R2", "vref", "e3", R2)
    n.R("R3", "vref", "vss", R3)
    n.Q("Q3", "vss", "vss", "e3", m=1)
    n.C("CO", "vref", "vss", 1e-12)
    # start-up: PMOS detector gated by nb (tracks core PMOS Vth).
    # running: MD on -> sx ~ VDD -> MS (PMOS) off. dead: nb=VDD -> MD off, sx held low -> MS injects into na.
    n.M("MD", "sx", "nb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 4.0)
    n.M("MPD1", "sx1", "vdd", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 20.0)
    n.M("MPD2", "sx", "vss", "sx1", "vss", "nfet", 0.42, 20.0)   # off: leakage-level pull-down only
    n.C("CS", "sx", "vss", 200e-15)
    n.M("MS", "na", "sx", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 0.42, 4.0)

    # predictions
    veb = lambda i: 0.76 + UT * math.log(max(i, 1e-12) / 10e-6)
    iq3 = 0.1 * I; v3 = veb(iq3)
    for _ in range(30):
        iq3 = max((I * R3 - v3) / (R2 + R3), 1e-10); v3 = veb(iq3)
    k = R3 / (R2 + R3)
    vref = k * (v3 + I * R2)
    dveb = (v3 - 1.2) / 300.15 - 3 * UT / 300.15
    slope = k * (dveb + I * R2 / 300.15)
    tc = abs(slope) / vref * 1e6 + 300
    rout = R2 * R3 / (R2 + R3)
    dv = mp.gds * rout * 2.0 + 0.01
    psrr = -db(max(dv, 1e-6))
    power = 1.8 * (3 * I + 0.05e-6)
    return n, {"vref": vref, "tc_ppm": tc, "line_reg": dv,
               "power": power, "psrr_1k": psrr, "startup_ok": 1}

events.topology: Op-amp-less PTAT core (PNP 1:8, NMOS level-shift, long-L PMOS mirror) + scaled bandgap output (R2 to PNP, R3 shunt) + inverter start-up

events.reason: Start-up PMOS gated by vref (~0.66V) never turns off and MS shorts nb to na, creating a false state (line_reg 1.2V/V, TC 7156). Replace with an na-sensing inverter (weak PMOS) and a pull-down kick on

Large line_reg and negative PSRR suggest the start-up stays on and holds nb low, so M5 tracks VDD. Rebuilt start-up with weak, long-L devices, an extra pull-down shutting MS off, and a 20 nA cap. Avoi

Core stuck at low/false state (vref 0.43, low power, line_reg>1): stacked PMOS+body-effected NMOS+BJT lacks headroom. Replace with weak-inversion NMOS beta-multiplier (R1 from LUT-solved dVgs), keep Q

TC 2900 ppm and 0.32 V/V line reg are large-signal breakdowns. Small-signal PSRR is 0.022, so the core is fine. The NMOS detector gated by vref (0.62 V, near Vth) likely drops out cold or at VDD shift
Topology works; vref 4% low and PSRR 1.1 dB short. Raise a (R3, divider k) to lift vref to ~0.66 V; larger Cg and longer Lp improve 1 kHz PSRR. Other specs have margin.
